config firewall address
edit "Prefix-Web Server"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-DNS Quoted Name"
set subnet 1.1.1.1 255.255.255.255
next

edit "Prefix-Range Object"
set type iprange
set start-ip 10.0.0.1
set end-ip 10.0.0.5
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set member "Prefix-Web Server" "Prefix-DNS Quoted Name" "Prefix-Range Object"
next

end
